Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The only change is `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION:1`, from 68 to 69. This change meets the rule in AGENTS.md for a separate version PR after a process merge batch. Both cited merges are on upstream/main. Both changed `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`. The body has the required process and changelog lines. This version PR does not close an issue.

Local checks against upstream/main at e2f012e90c3174fb308344e5122bb39e70531d90:
- Trial merge: clean; main is already in the PR branch.
- `git diff --check upstream/main HEAD`: passed.
- File and value checks: passed. Only the version file changed. The value increased by one.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run`: passed. The local xtask build passed. The plan has no tests because no crate changed.
- Application build, tests, and clippy: not run. This PR changes one process value and no Rust code.

Requested changes: none.

This PR does not change G-code, geometry, collision checks, stock simulation, UI, or golden files. Mutation tests and screenshots do not apply.

After merge, the merging session must post the version notice on #681, as AGENTS.md requires.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
